supersedes.reason: The v1 phase-1 paths target the terminal-rejected recovery1 controller; v2 binds only the accepted recovery2 capability path and its fresh full-run successors.

purpose: Maximize accepted recent same-track comparators while preserving all recovery2 result and failure evidence before releasing any later heavy stage.
global_release_gate: the recovery2 Wave1 controller is TERMINAL_ACCEPTED without TERMINAL_REJECTED
all recovery2 answer, embedding, evaluator, and controller processes have exited
no process references a fresh target of the next stage
fresh-root, storage-headroom, source-identity, and protected-model checks pass
recovery2_failure_branch: If the recovery2 controller rejects, preserve every root, freeze a diagnosis and successor, and do not enter any phase below.

phases.reason: Recovery2 accepted evidence, historical failure evidence, and the canonical local ledger must all be immutable before any new acquisition.
execution_order: run the four-stage recovery2 closure chain
archive the five frozen failure-history roots separately
promote all four accepted method summaries into the 660-row local ledger
independently audit all inventories and terminal markers
phases.exit_gate: Recovery2 closure, accepted and failure archives, projection overlay, and 660-row admission bundle are independently TERMINAL_ACCEPTED.

phases.reason: The frozen lifecycle covers eight methods and has the highest comparator yield per setup transition.
phases.exit_gate: Every eligible lifecycle root is audited; only then freeze its three-seed numerical successor.

phases.reason: MemoryOS and MemGAS add two recent official-code comparators with moderate model footprint.
phases.exit_gate: Both lifecycle roots are audited; only then freeze their three-seed numerical successors.

phases.reason: Hindsight is a recent official-code comparator with a larger isolated dependency surface and embedded service.
phases.exit_gate: The embedded-service lifecycle is audited; only then freeze its three-seed numerical successor.

phases.reason: StructMem is retained as an ACL 2026 comparator with exact source and model identity, but its dependency chain requires post-lock successors.
phases.exit_gate: Freeze and accept lock export, wheelhouse, isolated environment, lifecycle, and then the three-seed numerical successor.

numeric_admission.agentenhance_gate: AgentEnhance remains locked until all runnable required public baselines have accepted local summaries or an immutable external blocker is audited.

failure_semantics: Preserve and audit every rejected stage. A fresh successor may change only a predeclared technical mechanism; never change method, seed, sample, metric, or slice selection after values exist.
cleanup: Only project-owned run-specific model targets may enter the separate ownership, dependency, archive, quarantine, and deletion policy after their accepted data are archived; shared or pre-existing Qwen models never do.
prohibited: using any recovery1 result as recovery2 evidence
starting a later phase before the preceding exit gate
running a heavy archive, model acquisition, wheelhouse, or numerical job concurrently
skipping an unfavorable accepted method, seed, sample, metric, or slice
starting AgentEnhance early to choose favorable baseline coverage
claiming overall SOTA from a lifecycle, archive, partial comparison, or favorable slice alone
